methods.label: Work backward by subtraction
methods.explanation:
The sum rule can be reversed: knowing a term and one of the two terms that produced it lets us subtract to find the other. First, \(S_9=S_7+S_8\), so
\[
S_8=110-42=68.
\]
Now \(S_7\) and \(S_8\) are known adjacent terms, allowing us to continue backward:
\[
\begin{aligned}
S_6&=S_8-S_7=68-42=26,\\
S_5&=S_7-S_6=42-26=16,\\
S_4&=S_6-S_5=26-16=10.
\end{aligned}
\]
Each subtraction determines the earlier term uniquely. Thus \(S_4=10\), choice C.
